About Us

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation,  Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Summary: A hands-on Manager to own HighRadius's web platform and marketing analytics infrastructure, ensuring clean attribution, strong technical SEO health, and reliable lead data while leading a team.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing technology, web operations, and analytics. The Manager will be responsible for keeping HubSpot and the CDP layer clean and reliable, managing the WordPress site, monitoring AWS server logs for performance and crawl issues, and ensuring leads are accurately attributed across Organic and Paid channels in a non-branded paid search environment. A strong grasp of Core Web Vitals and cross-region, cross-device optimization is essential to improving impression share globally.

Responsibilities

  • Own HubSpot & CDP infrastructure: Manage HubSpot in conjunction with CDPs to ensure clean data flow, accurate lead records, and reliable handoffs between marketing automation and the sales/CRM stack.
  • Manage the WordPress environment: Oversee day-to-day site management on WordPress, including content updates, plugin/theme maintenance, page performance, and coordination with developers on fixes and enhancements.
  • Add technical skill requirements
  • Monitor AWS server health: Review AWS server logs to identify uptime issues, latency, crawl errors, or anomalies impacting site performance and SEO, and work with engineering to resolve them.
  • Drive accurate lead attribution: Ensure leads generated are correctly attributed across Organic and Paid channels, maintaining clean UTM hygiene and resolving attribution gaps given that HighRadius does not bid on branded keywords, in close coordination with marketing analytics and SFDC reporting.
  • Champion Core Web Vitals: Own Core Web Vitals performance (LCP, INP, CLS) across the site, partnering with engineering on fixes that improve page experience and search visibility.
  • Improve global impression share: Identify opportunities to grow organic impressions and visibility across target geographies (US, UK, Ireland, Canada, France, DACH, etc.), tailoring strategy by region.
  • Optimize across devices: Maintain strong technical and UX performance on both mobile and desktop, ensuring parity in speed, rendering, and search performance across device types.

 

Technical Skills Required

  • Backend: PHP, OOP
  • CMS: WordPress (Custom Themes, Plugins, Theme Customization)
  • Database: MySQL, SQL
  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, React.js, Next.js
  • CRM: HubSpot
  • Servers: Linux, FTP/SFTP
  • APIs: GraphQL, REST APIs (optional but recommended)

Must Haves

  • 5-8 years of experience in web development, MarTech, and web analytics within a B2B SaaS or enterprise environment.
  • 5-8 years of hands-on experience with HubSpot and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), including configuration, data syncing, and troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of WordPress administration, including plugins, themes, and basic site management.
  • Comfortably reading and interpreting AWS server logs to diagnose performance and crawlability issues.
  • Proven people management experience, having led a team of 4 or more individual contributors.
  • Strong understanding of marketing attribution, UTM tracking, and channel-level lead classification (Organic vs. Paid).
  • Solid grasp of Core Web Vitals and technical SEO fundamentals, with experience driving cross-functional fixes.
  • Experience optimising for both mobile and desktop performance, with familiarity across multiple geographic markets.

48b29cfabfc7e015.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Planning & Onboarding
    • Own the end-to-end campaign setup process — from brief intake and media planning to creative specifications, trafficking, and go-live
    • Translate advertiser KPIs (ROAS, CPL, CTR, incremental lift) into campaign structures suited for Razorpay's Transaction Ads inventory and Audience Intelligence activations on Meta and Google
    • Coordinate with sales and advertiser teams to define targeting parameters, audience segments, budget pacing, and flight schedules
    • Ensure all campaigns are launched accurately and on time, with proper tracking and attribution in place
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization
    • Monitor live campaigns daily across Razorpay Media Network (in-transaction and post-transaction placements) and offsite channels (Meta, Google)
    • Proactively identify underperforming campaigns and implement optimizations across bids, creatives, audience segments, and pacing
    • Manage budget allocation across campaigns to maximize delivery and performance against KPIs
    • Work with the publisher operations team to troubleshoot delivery issues and ensure inventory health on 3P publisher platforms
  • Client Reporting & Insights
    • Build and deliver regular performance reports (weekly, mid-flight, end-of-campaign) with clear insights and recommendations
    • Present campaign results to advertiser POCs and agency teams, demonstrating ROI and identifying opportunities for upsell or renewed investment
    • Develop standardized reporting templates and dashboards that scale across the campaign portfolio
  • Audience Intelligence Campaign Management
    • Set up and manage transaction graph-based audience segments for activation on Meta and Google
    • Coordinate with the data and product teams on segment availability, refresh cycles, and match rate optimization
    • Support advertiser teams in interpreting audience performance data and refining segment strategies across campaign cycles
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Partner with enterprise sales during the pre-sales phase to validate campaign feasibility, scope delivery timelines, and set realistic performance expectations
    • Work closely with product on feature gaps, delivery bugs, and tooling improvements that impact campaign operations
    • Coordinate with creative and agency partners to ensure ad assets meet platform specifications and quality standards
    • Feed structured performance insights back to the sales team for renewals, upsells, and new business pitches
  • Process & Operations
  • Maintain accurate campaign trackers, status dashboards, and pacing reports across the entire active portfolio
  • Document SOPs for campaign onboarding, optimization workflows, and reporting cadences
  • Flag risks proactively — budget overruns, delivery shortfalls, creative fatigue — and drive resolution before they impact client outcomes

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline; quantitative or business backgrounds preferred
  • 3–6 years of experience in campaign management, ad operations, or performance marketing — ideally at a DSP, ad network, publishers in ecommerce, UPI, quick commerce apps or performance marketing agency managing Meta/Google campaigns
  • Hands-on experience managing campaigns on programmatic ad stack, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (DV360 or Programmatic is a plus)
  • Strong analytical ability — comfortable working with campaign data in Excel/Sheets, pulling insights, and identifying optimization levers without hand-holding
  • Experience with audience-based targeting strategies (custom audiences, lookalikes, contextual, behavioral segments)
  • Familiarity with tracking and measurement frameworks — pixel setup, conversion events, UTM parameters, and attribution models
  • Excellent client-facing communication skills; able to present performance data clearly to marketing and agency stakeholders
  • High ownership mentality — able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining quality and SLA commitments
  • Prior exposure to retail media, commerce media, or fintech advertising is a strong plus
  • BFSI advertiser experience (banks, credit cards, insurance, fintech) is an advantage

We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our People team needs a hands-on partner who can coach managers and run the operational engine at the same time. You'll be the first line of support for managers and employees on policy, performance, and growth, while owning payroll, leaves, benefits, and the employee lifecycle end to end. You'll step in during a major Q1 2027 systems transition, protecting talent density, keeping pay and compliance airtight, and freeing our People leadership to focus on strategy.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Be the first point of contact for managers and employees on policy, performance, corrective feedback, and growth

• Coach managers on feedback, documentation, and follow-ups, with hands-on support through performance and termination situations that keep talent density high and legal risk low

• Run People Team 1:1s and exit interviews for Levels 1 and 2, and surface culture themes, flight risks, and training gaps for our quarterly People Pulse report

• Administer leaves (FMLA, ADA, state, STD, parental) and accommodation requests from start to finish, and oversee workers' comp claims

• Own payroll accuracy across HQ, field, and international teams by resolving complications directly with our partners and tracking every issue to closure

• Own benefits administration end to end: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, carrier coordination, renewals, and clear employee communication

• Own onboarding and offboarding, so every new hire starts with complete paperwork and correct pay, and every exit closes out cleanly on final pay, benefits notices, and access

• Keep employee data clean (levels, titles, departments, managers, compensation) so comp, survey, and headcount decisions are always backed by accurate data

• Support employees through our Q1 2027 payroll, benefits, and retirement platform changes

• Turn repeat work into AI-supported workflows, and know when AI shouldn't be involved

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 5+ years scaling HR support, ideally on a coordinator to HRBP to HR Generalist track in a fast-growing consumer or DTC company

• Has hands-on payroll administration experience

• Has run leaves (FMLA, ADA, state leaves, STD, parental) and workers' comp end to end

• Has administered benefits: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, and open enrollment

• Has a track record in employee relations and manager coaching, including performance documentation and terminations

• Has handled sensitive employee situations and exits with discretion and good judgment

• Has working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, COBRA, E-Verify, and multi-state leave and final pay laws

• Bonus: payroll or HRIS migration or acquisition integration experience, and Paylocity experience

Approach to the role:

• You bring a customer service mindset: you acknowledge fast, focus on solutions, and can't rest until every loop is closed

• You're detail-obsessed about anything that touches someone's pay

• You treat every interaction as if it could land on the front page of the NY Times

• You build real relationships and stay culture-aligned while making decisions in the best interest of Grüns

• You have extreme ownership and self-motivation, so micromanagement isn't needed because you're always 10 steps ahead

• You use AI to protect your focus for thoughtful people partnership

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gruns-people-operations-manager

489774d80a7b9c4b.description:
🌍 About Hopae
At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.
Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.
Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here
• 
Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco
• 
High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape
• 
Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability
• 
Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers
• 
Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision
• 
Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

This position is open only for candidates based in the US & LATAM

🎯 What You'll Do

The Americas is where Hopae’s next wave of growth gets built. The US, Brazil, Mexico and
Argentina are live on Hopae Connect, and demand is coming from three directions at once: IDV providers adding government eID coverage, eSignature platforms facing new compliance deadlines, and regulated industries that need to verify real people across borders. 
As Senior Account Executive, Americas, you own that territory end to end. You are accountable to revenue, not activity.

• Own the full cycle. First conversation to signed contract: qualification, technical discovery, commercial structuring, negotiation, and close. No handoffs to hide behind.
• Sell across all three of our buyer types. IDV’s, eSignature providers, and medium to large regulated industry players. You will learn to move between a platform integration conversation and a bank compliance conversation in the same week.
• Sell the recurring motion, not just the one-time check. Our strongest accounts use eID verification for ongoing login and session assurance, not a single onboarding event. Building that story into every deal is a core part of the job.
• Work direct and through resellers. A meaningful share of Americas revenue arrives through resellers whose own customers are the real relying party. You will also sell directly to large platform companies that need ID verification in many countries. (banks, casinos, crypto, ride share, etc.)
• Partner with BDR and Marketing on pipeline. You will inherit a researched target list and a BDR to work with, and you are expected to self-source alongside it.
• Run a credible technical sale. Work directly with Engineering and Product on integration scoping, sandbox evaluations, and production testing, so deals close on substance rather
than enthusiasm.
• Keep the forecast honest. Clean HubSpot hygiene, real stage discipline, and a number you stand behind. We would rather hear bad news early than good news that does not land.
• Be the voice of the Americas internally. Which countries, rails and use cases you keep hearing about should shape what Hopae builds and where it goes next.

🧠 Who You Are

• Experience: 6 to 8 years in B2B SaaS or API and infrastructure sales, with at least 3 years carrying a full-cycle quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You have closed deals where legal, security and compliance all had a veto.
• Market: Background in identity, KYC and AML, payments, fintech infrastructure, or reg tech. You understand why verifying a person in Brazil is a different problem from verifying one in Denmark.
• Technical Credibility: Comfortable with API-first products. You can read documentation, run a discovery call with engineers in the room, and scope an integration without needing a solutions engineer on every call.
• Territory & Language: Based in the Americas, with real coverage experience across the US and Latin America. Fluent in English is required; Spanish and/or Portuguese are a significant advantage for the LatAm side of the territory, but not required.
• Commercial Range: Equally at home selling direct to an enterprise and selling through a reseller or platform partner, including deals where your customer’s customer is the one who actually needs the verification.
• How You Work: Outcome-driven and self-directed. You set your own targets based on quota, hold yourself to them, and operate well across time zones in an async, global team.
• Bonus: Experience with LatAm identity rails (INE, CPF, CNH, RENAPER), regulated-industry selling, or the eIDAS 2.0 and EUDI Wallet landscape.

⚡️ Fast Facts

💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors
• 
📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library
• 
🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs
• 
🔬 82 eID research projects completed
• 
🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

🎁 Benefits & Culture

Unlimited PTO

Remote-friendly work model

Real ownership from Day 1

High-impact, global product

Multicultural, respectful team

Offer 🎉

Headquarters: Remote

The Team + The Role

Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.

Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.

This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

• Enterprise positioning: Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.

• Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.

• Flexible execution: Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.

• AI-enabled GTM: Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.

• Market research: Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.

• Sales partnership: Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.

• Testing and iteration: Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.

• Enterprise content: Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.

• Enterprise strategy support: Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Product Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

• A proven track record of building and shipping product marketing work, with depth of ownership that matters more than the number of years in seat.

• Experience creating, testing, and adapting product marketing work in fast-moving, high-growth, startup, or similarly ambiguous environments.

• AI fluency, including comfort working in an AI-shaped environment and using AI tools or workflows to improve research, content creation, and execution.

• Ability to operate in ambiguity, move across shifting priorities, and flex into adjacent areas such as solutions marketing, growth, and demand generation.

• Exceptional ability to translate technical product features into compelling, value-driven solutions for buyers.

• Demonstrated experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and developing targeted messaging.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.

• Ability to travel occasionally.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience building AI agents or workflows to accelerate product marketing or go-to-market work.

• Experience supporting Enterprise marketing, Enterprise sales motions, or strategic Enterprise deals.

• Experience contributing to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, or enablement programs tailored for Enterprise markets.

• Experience developing Enterprise-facing collateral such as presentations, white papers, and case studies.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: We welcome remote candidates for this role! If you happen to live near one of our office hubs, you’re always welcome to join our hybrid team in person a few days a week, but living near an office is not required for this position.

Compensation: The expected salary range for this role to be performed in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY is $145,400 - $175,000, and in Raleigh, NC is $132,200 - $159,000.

Benefits: Pendo offers highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage in the United States, including $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pendo-sr-product-marketing-manager

481c77bf005e0aba.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To Team

Air Supply is Expedia Group’s airline connectivity platform — the engine that unifies airline content and booking fulfillment across a wide range of distribution channels and partners. We power the traveler-facing booking experience, marketing and acquisition channels, and integrations with airline partners, all while running a platform that has to stay reliable at massive transaction volumes with zero tolerance for one airline’s issue affecting others. We’re looking for a Product Manager III to help drive the roadmap for airline onboarding, partner capability expansion (like seats, bags, exchanges, and refunds), and platform reliability — turning a mature connectivity platform into a modern, AI-native supply platform that dramatically speeds up how quickly new airline partners can be onboarded.

In This Role, You Will

• Define and execute product strategy and roadmap for airline connectivity capabilities — partner onboarding, capability builds, and platform reliability — using data and experimentation to prioritize across a large, multi-partner portfolio.
• Translate airline partner, business, and engineering needs into clear problem statements and detailed requirements — including API contracts and data needs — for delivery to engineering teams.
• Collaborate closely with engineering, technical program managers, and cross-functional stakeholders (reservations, checkout, search, legal, and partner operations) to drive end-to-end delivery of airline capabilities, ensuring compliant, scalable integrations and strong operational performance (booking success rates, reliability, uptime).
• Use quantitative and qualitative insights — performance trends, incident patterns, delivery predictability — to monitor product performance, continuously iterate on the platform, and manage trade-offs across partner commitments, technical debt, and business impact.
• Partner with engineering and data science to safely integrate AI and agentic capabilities into the platform and its operations (e.g., incident triage, issue diagnosis, onboarding acceleration).
• Influence cross-functional and cross-organizational stakeholders, aligning them around a clear product vision, and communicate priorities, risks, and progress across multiple workstreams and airline programs.

Minimum Qualifications

• Must have- Experience in airline or travel distribution, connectivity platforms, or supplier/partner-facing products.
• Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in a technical, analytical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience in product delivery within technology organizations.
• Min 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, including ownership of a product, feature set, or service from discovery through launch and iteration, working with engineering and technical program managers in an agile environment.
• Proven ability to define product requirements, write clear user stories or PRDs, interpret data and metrics, and use experimentation to inform roadmap decisions.
• Demonstrated experience collaborating with engineering on system behavior, API-level requirements, data flows, and dependencies to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable integrations.

If you are passionate about data and have a keen interest in utilizing advanced technologies to drive business success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

48637286f119a2d7.description: We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic team in the Mumbai region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering and be proficient in various data processing technologies. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data pipelines that facilitate the efficient processing and storage of large datasets. You will work closely with data scientists and analysts to ensure that data is accessible and usable for analytical purposes. Key Responsibilities: - Design and implement ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data warehouses and data lakes. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver high-quality data solutions. - Optimize data pipelines for performance and scalability, ensuring that they can handle large volumes of data efficiently. - Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues, ensuring data integrity and availability. - Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies in data engineering and apply them to improve existing processes. Required Skills: - Proficiency in Informatica and Snowflake for data integration and warehousing. - Experience with Spark or PySpark for big data processing. - Familiarity with Hadoop or Hive for data storage and querying. - Strong understanding of ETL processes and data engineering principles. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with stakeholders. If you are passionate about data engineering and have the required skills, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our innovative team.
